executiveSummary: Today's AI picture is being shaped by open-source stack, workflow orchestration, customer operations. The strongest signals point to a market where research progress, platform controls, and workflow execution are converging into more operational buying criteria.

Execution architecture is becoming more important than one-shot generation quality in operational AI.
Customer operations AI is shifting from note-taking to controlled action recommendation and orchestration.
